recruitment: Telangana Police Recruitment 2026 — SCT SI (Civil) and equivalent posts
purpose: The 25 facts Phase 1 must establish from official documents. Each record is a slot with a provenance block, not a fact. A record holds a value only when the document behind it has been retrieved, stored and hashed.
blocked_reason: No official TGPRB / TSLPRB document has been retrieved. Network egress from this environment permits one unrelated host, so no official URL can be fetched. See source_material/official/RETRIEVAL_LOG.md and blocker B-09.
rules: value stays null while status is not VERIFIED. A value without provenance is a fabrication regardless of how plausible it looks.
provenance.document_id must name a document whose retrieval_status is RETRIEVED in config/official_documents.json.
provenance.quote must be verbatim text from the document, so a later reader can re-check the reading without re-downloading.
status is one of BLOCKED, UNVERIFIED, VERIFIED. No fourth value; no 'probably'.
value_te is the Telugu companion field required from day one by D-0004; it is a translation of a sourced value, never an independent claim.

facts.name: Notification number
facts.must_capture: The Rc. / notification number exactly as printed, including its year and issuing section.

facts.name: Notification date
facts.must_capture: The date the notification was issued, as printed on the document itself rather than inferred from a file name.

facts.name: Application dates
facts.must_capture: Opening date, closing date, fee-payment window, and any correction window, each with its cut-off time if stated.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). A supplementary notification may amend these, so DOC-OFF-003 must be read before any date is treated as final.

facts.name: Number of vacancies
facts.must_capture: Total vacancies and the per-post breakdown as tabulated, plus whether the figure is stated as provisional or subject to variation.

facts.name: Post codes
facts.must_capture: Every post code in the recruitment, exactly as the notification numbers them, with the post each code denotes.

facts.name: Post names
facts.must_capture: Full official post names, including the SCT prefix and any 'or equivalent' wording, in the notification's own words.

facts.name: Eligibility requirements
facts.must_capture: Every eligibility condition: nationality, local-candidate status, marital or dependants clauses if any, disqualifications, and any post-specific condition.

facts.name: Educational qualifications
facts.must_capture: The required qualification per post code, the cut-off date by which it must be held, and how equivalence is treated.

facts.name: Age requirements
facts.must_capture: Minimum and maximum age, the reference date on which age is computed, and every relaxation with the category it applies to.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Age limits differ by post and category, so a single number would be wrong even if the range were remembered correctly.

facts.name: Reservation and category rules
facts.must_capture: Reservation percentages and rules as the notification states them, including horizontal reservations and the certificate each requires.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Reservation rules are legal provisions; paraphrasing them is not acceptable and guessing them is worse.

facts.name: Preliminary Written Test structure
facts.must_capture: Whether the PWT is one paper or several, objective or otherwise, its mode, and whether it is qualifying or counts towards the final merit.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Whether the PWT is merely qualifying changes how a candidate should allocate months of preparation, so it must not be assumed.

facts.name: PWT subjects
facts.must_capture: The subject names as the notification lists them, in its order, with each subject's stated scope. These become the top level of the official syllabus.

facts.name: PWT number of questions
facts.must_capture: Question count per paper and per subject if broken down.

facts.name: PWT marks
facts.must_capture: Maximum marks per paper, marks per question, and how marks map to the final selection if at all.

facts.name: PWT duration
facts.must_capture: Time allowed per paper, plus any compensatory time provision.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Duration drives every timed-practice setting in this system, so an invented figure would silently mistrain pacing.

facts.name: Negative marking
facts.must_capture: Whether marks are deducted for a wrong answer, the exact deduction, and the treatment of unattempted or multiply-marked answers.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Presence or absence of negative marking inverts the correct guessing strategy, so this must never be assumed in either direction.

facts.name: Minimum qualifying requirements
facts.must_capture: Qualifying marks or percentages per stage and per category, and any separate sectional minimum.

facts.name: Physical Measurement Test requirements
facts.must_capture: Every measured standard with its unit and the category or gender it applies to, plus how measurement is conducted and whether it is qualifying.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Values land in physical/standards/ only from an official document; that folder is enforced empty until then, because wrong physical targets waste months of training and can injure.

facts.name: Physical Efficiency Test requirements
facts.must_capture: Each event, its qualifying standard per category and gender, the number of attempts permitted, and whether events are scored or purely qualifying.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). Same physical-standards rule as OFF-F18.

facts.name: Final Written Examination structure
facts.must_capture: Number of papers, their mode, whether descriptive or objective, and how the FWE contributes to final merit.

facts.name: FWE subjects
facts.must_capture: Subject names and their stated scope per paper, in the notification's own order and wording. These become official syllabus subjects for the FWE.

facts.name: FWE marks
facts.must_capture: Maximum marks per paper, marks per question if stated, and the aggregate used for merit.

facts.name: FWE duration
facts.must_capture: Time allowed per paper.

facts.name: Selection sequence
facts.must_capture: The ordered stages from application to final selection, which stages are eliminating, which contribute marks, and the ratio used to shortlist at each stage.
facts.blocked_reason: No official document retrieved (B-09). The order of stages determines what to prepare first; an assumed order could waste an entire preparation cycle.

facts.name: Official instructions affecting preparation
facts.must_capture: Instructions that change how a candidate should prepare: permitted languages and any language-of-question rule, calculator or device rules, syllabus annexures, translation-discrepancy clauses, tie-breaking rules, and any stated bar on material outside the syllabus.
